Add the public pyrus agreement preview proxy endpoint. (#115)

## Summary
Add the public pyrus agreement preview proxy endpoint.

## Changes
- Route GET /api/v1/agreement/preview through the existing public agreement router.
- Proxy preview requests to the universal /api/v1/agreement/preview upstream path while forwarding type, x-app, x-locale, and x-platform.
- Preserve upstream HTML status/body/content-type, defaulting preview responses to text/html when upstream omits content-type.
- Document inspect as JSON and preview as text/html in pyrus OpenAPI without adding an inspect format parameter.

## Verification
- just rosa pyrus test
- just rosa pyrus ci
- git diff --check
